claims.uncertainty: CEDIM classifies +80 to +109 cm as flood at the Punta della Salute reference point. This is a threshold, not an event peak.
194 cm uses Venice's Punta della Salute datum; values against mean sea level differ.
A stated design protection level, not a measured Venice flood.
Four barrier rows across three lagoon inlets.
UNESCO describes the World Heritage city as spread over 118 small islands; narration conservatively says more than one hundred.

animation_audit.finding: 241 was not a source value. It was a transient frame in a 0-to-300 spring count-up toward the verified 300 cm design limit.
animation_audit.v2_policy: Animate bar height only. Display the verified final number throughout and label 300 cm explicitly as a design limit.
animation_audit.v3_policy: Use 80 cm threshold, fixed source values, safe numeric-label margins, and information-bearing motion through settled chart frames.

foundations.v3_text: Waterlogged, oxygen-poor mud preserves the piles, but anaerobic bacteria still attack wood. Slow decay and the wood-water-soil system maintain stability.

mose_operation.v3_text: The barrier can hold back the Adriatic during closures; this is not a guarantee of permanent or universal protection.
